regime.label: Malaysia - MyInvois validation by IRBM
regime.correction_mechanism: credit note, debit note or refund note e-Invoice
regime.scope: Phased by annual turnover from 2024-08-01; taxpayers up to RM5 million from 2026-01-01, with interim relaxation to 2027-12-31.

commencement.scope: Annual turnover or revenue above RM100 million
Annual turnover or revenue above RM25 million up to RM100 million
Annual turnover or revenue above RM5 million up to RM25 million
Annual turnover or revenue up to RM5 million

regime.notes: IRBM validates each e-Invoice and returns a UUID before it is shared with the buyer. B2C sales without a buyer request may be grouped into one consolidated e-Invoice per month. Construction contractors under the Income Tax (Construction Contracts) Regulations 2007 may not consolidate (Specific Guideline section 3.7).

cancel.notes: Guideline v4.8 section 2.3.6: the supplier may cancel within 72 hours from the time of validation.

consolidation.notes: Specific Guideline v4.9 sections 3.6.2 (seven calendar days after month end), 3.7.2 item 7 (single transaction above RM10,000 from 2026-01-01) and table 16.1 (relaxation to 2027-12-31 for turnover up to RM5 million).
